items.title: fix(update): keep config-reader handoffs safe on Node and Bun (#158451)
items.summary: fix(update): keep config-reader handoffs safe on Node and Bun (#158451) Replace the URL-query child guard with a child-scoped environment marker and reject nested reader launches with candidate-config-read-recursion. Use one byte-length-framed stdout result transport for synchronous and asynchronous reads. Route ordinary stdout diagnostics to stderr and remove fd 3, which Bun 1.4.2 omits from spawnSync output. Preserve fresh candidate dependencies, rollback reads, and existing fail-soft service-definition behavior. Fixes #158339; thanks @hannesrudolph for the report.
